about.label: About
about.title: A bit about me
about.subtitle: Software Engineering student at Girne University · Ankara
paragraphs: I'm studying software engineering and I write code not just for coursework, but to ship real products. In summer 2025 I interned at 4B Software on the Esnaf Kefalet project, building a corporate web panel — my first serious industry experience.
After the training period I spent three months interning and six months on the project in a real work environment — that's where I learned deadlines, team communication, and delivery culture.
These days I'm growing through personal projects and modern web tech. I'm open to new projects and collaborations.

esnaf-kefalet.title: Esnaf Kefalet
paragraphs: Web-based admin panel for managing credits, contacts, and CRUD operations for Esnaf Kefalet. Built in a real work environment with the team during my internship.
A corporate admin interface where users can track credit records, manage contact information, and run basic reporting workflows.
Work included database schema design, form validation, session handling, and a user-friendly panel UI.
highlights: Corporate CRUD panel working with real client data
Server-side business logic with PHP and MySQL
Team communication and delivery discipline during internship + project phase

akilli-dosyalama.title: Smart Filing
paragraphs: Desktop app that automatically organizes folders and files on your computer according to rules you define.
Users can set rules by extension, date, or keyword to move scattered files into target folders.
Built with Electron for a cross-platform desktop experience and a UI kept simple for daily use.

kuponum.title: Kuponum
paragraphs: A mobile prediction game where you guess match results, with a duel system built around those predictions.
Players build coupons, make predictions, and earn points through duels. The in-app Tips section offers match hints to help with predictions. Top performers on the monthly leaderboard receive rewards.
Built with Flutter; prediction flow, Tips section, ranking system, and reward mechanics follow a gamification-first approach.
highlights: Gamified experience with match predictions and duel mechanics
In-app Tips section for match prediction hints
